policy.qualification: Only the unmodified stock profile can establish campaign correctness.
policy.compatibility: Derived cartridges may receive separate compatibility runs only after stock gates pass.
policy.privacy: ROM, SRAM, emulator-state, and symbol bytes stay outside version control; only fingerprints and provenance are committed.
